block.description: This provider addresses a shortcoming of `terraform_data` where sensitive values are output as plain text in the `plan.`

id.description: A string value unique to the resource instance.

input.description: A value which will be stored in the instance state, and reflected in the `output` attribute after apply.

input_sensitive.description: A value which will be stored in the instance state, and reflected as a sensitive value in the `output_sensitive` attribute after apply.

output.description: The computed value derived from the `input` argument. During a plan where `output` is unknown, it will still be of the same type as `input`.

output_sensitive.description: The sensitive computed value derived from the `input_sensitive` argument. During a plan where `output_sensitive` is unknown, it will still be of the same type as `input_sensitive`.

triggers_replace.description: A value that is stored in the instance state and will force replacement when the value changes.

block.description: Mimics the functionality of the `terraform_data` builtin resource, but with added attributes for storing sensitive inputs.
